title: Price Breakdown
description: Breaks down how the buyer's effective price is composed from list_price. Adjustment kinds: fee and operator_fee increase the price, discount reduces it, and commission and settlement are disclosed without changing it. Invariant: list_price with fee, discount, and operator_fee adjustments applied in array order, rounded to currency precision at each step (or to the option's price precision when it declares price_adjustments, see price-adjustments.json, which can be finer), equals fixed_price when the parent object carries it; on auction-based packages the breakdown is informational. Sellers never emit operator_fee. The operator's buying platform adds it after every fee and discount; the running price before the first operator_fee is the seller's price, to which commission and settlement apply. Budgets are denominated at fixed_price, inclusive of commissions; a buying platform's budget toward the advertiser also includes operator fees.

list_price.description: Rate card or base price before any adjustments. The starting point from which fixed_price is derived by applying fee, discount, and operator_fee adjustments sequentially.

adjustments.description: Ordered list of price adjustments. Fee, discount, and operator_fee adjustments walk list_price to the buyer's effective price — fees and operator fees increase the running price, discounts reduce it. Commission and settlement adjustments are disclosed for transparency but do not affect the buyer's committed price.

name.description: Specific adjustment name. Use well-known values where applicable for interoperability.

rate.description: Adjustment as a decimal proportion (e.g., 0.15 for 15%). Always positive — kind determines the economic effect. Mutually exclusive with amount.

amount.description: Adjustment as a fixed monetary amount in the pricing option's currency. Always positive — kind determines the economic effect. Mutually exclusive with rate.

description.description: Human-readable description of this adjustment (e.g., 'Malstaffel 12x', '2% Skonto 10 Tage')

beneficiary.description: Identifies who receives this adjustment's value. For commissions, the intermediary (e.g., a sellers.json domain, an AdCP account ID, or a human-readable party name). Optional but recommended for multi-intermediary transparency. For operator_fee, defaults to the account's operator; set it only when another party, such as the buying platform, receives the fee.
